Class NPC

java.lang.Object
model.Entity
model.Character
model.NPC
All Implemented Interfaces:
Interactable
public class NPC extends Character implements Interactable
A class describing an NPC. It contains its dialogue lines and implements the Interactable interface to allow player interaction.
